details: What Claude's check found
Picture A: The bays of the grid hold round clay pans, one in each; the plan's roof has Mangalore roof tiles laid in pairs in each bay.
Picture B: The deck is longer and narrower than in picture 1, and the stacks of pans and the upturned pan stand in a corner where the reverse of picture 1 would not have them.

Description

The top of a small house's roof under construction, open to the sky: a flat deck of tan shuttering boards with side boards at the edges, on which the steel grid, tiles and concrete are placed in turn; trees and a neighbouring roof beyond.
Shots
Used in 6 shots; the closest is a close-up (shot 1 of gap 9).
What Claude saw in each picture

A · the whole place: A wide view from above of a board deck with side boards, a tied steel grid on grey blocks, trees and a neighbouring tiled roof beyond, a trowel and an upturned pan at the edge. The bays hold round clay pans, not Mangalore tiles; a few bars end loose on the deck.

B · from the other side: The deck seen along its length with the bare grid in front and the round clay pans beyond, trees all round. The stacks, the tools and the proportions of the deck do not sit where a reverse view of picture 1 would put them, and no neighbouring roof is seen.

C · its fixed things: A near view of the tied ribbed bars on grey cover blocks over dusty tan boards with footprints, the upright side board behind, a neighbouring tiled roof and palms soft beyond; the bars and blocks match the footage well. Round clay pans sit in the bays, not tiles.
What the image model did

The image model chose: It raised the grid from the yard of the footage onto a board deck at roof height and filled the bays with the round clay pans seen in the footage, adding scaffolding and timber props from web photographs.
It set aside: It left out the Mangalore roof tiles, which the footage shows stacked beside the grid and the plan names as the filler; it also left out the bare ground the footage grid lies on.
What the picture model searched
Searched: not known.
